svg.title: A Single Restoration Inquiry Cohort
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-loss-inquiry-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: A Single Restoration Inquiry Cohort; subtitle: 120 inquiries narrow to 30 fully collected jobs at day 120.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Hypothetical cohort followed for 120 days after intake closes. Every later group is a subset of the preceding group. Counts are neither annual sales forecasts nor recognized revenue.; caption: Separate lead qualification, completed work, and cash receipt; a paid-job count cannot substitute for earned contract revenue.; stages: label: Recorded inquiries; value: 120 inquiries; 100% of intake; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Log every unique loss inquiry with source, address, contact permission, and incident date; remove duplicate calls concerning the same property and event.; label: Qualified opportunities; value: 84 qualified; 70% of intake; numeric value: 84.0; detail: Retain jobs inside the service radius with appropriate credentials, accessible premises, available capacity, and a customer able to authorize work.; label: Authorized jobs; value: 48 signed; 57.1% of qualified; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Count only executed work authorizations with a defined scope and payment terms; insurer acknowledgment alone does not create customer authorization.; label: Completed and invoiced; value: 36 completed; 75% of authorized; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Require completed contracted scope, supporting job records, and an issued invoice; twelve authorized jobs remain outside this completed subset.; label: Fully collected jobs; value: 30 collected; 83.3% of completed; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Require cleared payment against the full outstanding invoice balance; six completed jobs remain unpaid or partially paid at the observation cutoff.

circle.title: label: Recorded inquiries; value: 120 inquiries; 100% of intake; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Log every unique loss inquiry with source, address, contact permission, and incident date; remove duplicate calls concerning the same property and event.

label: Qualified opportunities; value: 84 qualified; 70% of intake; numeric value: 84.0; detail: Retain jobs inside the service radius with appropriate credentials, accessible premises, available capacity, and a customer able to authorize work.

label: Authorized jobs; value: 48 signed; 57.1% of qualified; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Count only executed work authorizations with a defined scope and payment terms; insurer acknowledgment alone does not create customer authorization.

label: Completed and invoiced; value: 36 completed; 75% of authorized; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Require completed contracted scope, supporting job records, and an issued invoice; twelve authorized jobs remain outside this completed subset.

label: Fully collected jobs; value: 30 collected; 83.3% of completed; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Require cleared payment against the full outstanding invoice balance; six completed jobs remain unpaid or partially paid at the observation cutoff.

text.title: Assumptions: Hypothetical cohort followed for 120 days after intake closes. Every later group is a subset of the preceding group. Counts are neither annual sales forecasts nor recognized revenue.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Hypothetical cohort followed for 120 days after intake closes. Every later group is a subset of the preceding group.
